entries.name: 365 Data Science
entries.about: Courses and projects for data science, analytics, and statistics
entries.description: 365 Data Science is a course platform for data science, statistics, Excel, SQL, Python, and machine learning, with career-style projects alongside the lessons. It is study material, which is why it sits here instead of in the tool catalogue.

entries.name: AlgoMaster
entries.about: Pattern-based coding and system-design prep for technical interviews
entries.description: AlgoMaster teaches coding-interview patterns and system design through visualizations, question sets, and a newsletter. It is a study site for interview prep, not a tool you use to build or operate something.

entries.name: Bosscoder Academy
entries.about: Mentor-led DSA, system design, and interview programs for working engineers
entries.description: Bosscoder Academy runs structured upskilling programs for working software engineers: DSA, system design, mock interviews, and placement support, aimed at moving into product companies. A practice ground with coding problems sits alongside the paid programs.

entries.name: DevOps Interview Questions
entries.about: A collected question bank for DevOps interviews
entries.description: DevOps Interview Questions is an open GitHub list of questions and answers across DevOps topics. It is a study list you read, not a product you run.

entries.name: LabEx
entries.about: Hands-on labs for Linux, DevOps, and cybersecurity
entries.description: LabEx is a lab platform where you practice Linux, DevOps, Kubernetes, and cybersecurity inside guided exercises instead of watching a lecture. It is courseware with a terminal, which is why it is filed here rather than as a tool.
